items.summary: Remove all existing bullet point splitting logic from notesCleanerFormat.ts including convertToParagraphToPoints, convertToBulletPoints, and definition style bullet formatting functions

Implement semantic phrase detection that preserves scientific compound terms as single bullets: 'carbon dioxide and water', 'semi permeable membrane', 'low solute concentration', 'high solute concentration' must never be split
Implement smart splitting logic that only creates multiple bullets when 2 or more standalone technical phrases appear sequentially WITHOUT conjunctions (and/or/with/of/from/to/in/by/using/through)
Preserve complete sentences as single bullets when they contain subject + verb + descriptive clause or process explanation, preventing fragmentation
Implement validation rules to prevent single-word bullets, conjunction-led bullets, and modifier-separated bullets in all conversion modes

Apply semantic grouping before bullet conversion and prioritize meaning preservation over formatting in all three conversion modes: Convert Paragraph to Points, Convert to Bullet Points, and Definition Style Format
